Preparation and four stages

From the chosen case to observed value.

Open a stage. Mark it as done when you finish it in your case; progress remains in this page until you reload or leave it.

0

P1 Decision. Which decision is hard today and who needs to make it?

P2 Scope. Which sources, product and limits can the team handle?

P3 Accountability. Who answers for the result, prepares the data and authorises its use?

P4 Outcome. What evidence will show whether the first delivery helped?

Good criteria for a first case
  • Clear value for a real decision
  • A sponsor with authority over the domain
  • An available, authorised source
  • Low risk to start (avoid sensitive personal data in the first case)
Domain ownerData product ownerOperational stewardData discovery and consumption portal
  • Scoped use case
  • Named sponsor
  • Chosen value indicator

Decision point: The case has value, a sponsor and an available source.

Measures: Clarity of the decision supported; time to first delivery.

Domain charter

Markdown (.md) ↓Word (.docx) · PT-BR ↓Excel (.xlsx) · PT-BR ↓

No tool is needed: documents and a meeting are enough.

The council chooses to prioritise inspections: the decision is where to inspect first, the sponsor is the Inspection domain owner and the indicator is the share of inspections that confirm an irregularity.

One decision, end to end

A request becomes access through an explicit decision.

Review, decision and technical enforcement are distinct responsibilities. Every path leaves a record.

Choose an outcome and see the path
01 · Data discovery and consumption portalRequest and purposeThe consumer requests a version of the product and states what it will be used for.
02 · Operational stewardSteward reviewChecks purpose, meaning, classification and whether the product is suitable.
03 · Data product ownerOwner decisionApproves, rejects or escalates, always with a recorded justification.
04 · Technical custodianTechnical enforcementThe custodian implements exactly the approved scope and verifies it.
05 · Data discovery and consumption portalUse and reviewData discovery and consumption portal and owner review usage, term and need on the agreed date.
What is recorded

Scope, purpose, term and review date recorded before implementation; policy applied and verified.

Why it matters

Approval and implementation are distinct acts: whoever decides is not whoever enforces.

What if an exception is needed?

An exception records the rule affected, the justification, the risk, who approved it, the compensating control and the expiry date. It is not a permanent shortcut. Use the decision record.

Review rhythm

Light, regular and agreed.

Starting points. Adjust to the size of the team.

At every release

Review contract, owners, quality and access terms before delivery.

Weekly (starting point)

Triage problems, access requests and contract changes with the team.

Monthly (starting point)

Review outcomes, exceptions and policy improvements with the governance forum.
